text:
Silver Price in 2017
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2017, the LBMA silver price fell 2.5% between 2017-01-31 ($17.29) and 2017-12-29 ($16.87). The highest sampled price was $18.28 in February and the lowest was $16.47 in June. The mean of these observations was $17.17. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
